name: RFID Development Implant
description: The Doppelganger RFID Development Board is a more flexible platform for custom access control implant scenarios. It can be programmed for credential capture, emulation, or relay attacks, and its open platform allows custom firmware for specific access control system targets. It is the right tool when the ESPKey's fixed functionality is insufficient for the target environment's protocol or when a custom implant behavior is required.

blue.det: Physical tamper evidence on reader; reader malfunction; access log shows credential enumeration; OSDP tamper detection alert.
blue.cm: OSDP with AES-128 encryption renders implant useless; reader tamper detection and sealed installation; regular reader inspection; encrypted access control panel communication.
